faq-a-has-products:
As a comprehensive crypto exchange platform, EasiCoin provides low-barrier and well-rounded crypto asset services to global users, supporting hundreds of mainstream and emerging currencies. Core features include:

  • Trading a wide range of cryptocurrencies across Spot, Margin, and Futures markets;
  • Buying and selling crypto via C2C;
  • Using EasiCoin Earn products to earn yield on holdings;
  • Participating in EasiCoin Launchpad / Airdrop events;
  • Using loan services to meet funding needs via the "collateralize-borrow" model.
faq-a-how-buy:
EasiCoin offers multiple convenient ways to buy crypto:

  • Third-Party Payments: Instantly purchase crypto with Visa, Mastercard, and other supported cards in just one click.
  • P2P Trading: Buy and sell USDT or major cryptocurrencies via bank transfer securely and flexibly.
  • EasiCoin OTC: Over-the-counter services designed for high-volume transactions, available for individuals and institutions.
  • Quick Buy: Complete your deposit in just a few simple steps and start trading instantly.

Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced trader, EasiCoin makes buying digital assets simple, secure, and seamless.
faq-a-how-track: Monitor real-time price, trading volume, price changes, and market cap via currency detail pages. Access historical K-lines, 24-hour trading volume, and real-time data for key coins like BTC, ETH, and SOL.
faq-a-how-trade: Simply complete registration and KYC, then deposit or purchase crypto to start trading in EasiCoin’s spot, margin, and futures markets. The platform supports multiple order types and risk controls (e.g., limit, market, take-profit/stop-loss), along with beginner-friendly tutorials and guidance to simplify trading.
faq-a-is-safety: EasiCoin adopts bank-grade asset custody, hot and cold wallet segregation mechanism, multi-layer encryption technology, and KYC identity verification system to safeguard fund and data security.
faq-a-products-support: It currently supports Spot trading, USDT-Margined Perpetual Futures, RWA Stock Futures, and Gold RWA Perpetual Futures, as well as Demo Trading. More innovative products will be launched in succession.
